lead: A loop-goal.toml check can name a test that no crate can host *yet*, and the two reasons look identical from the driver's report.
body: A test "did not run" either because it was filed against the wrong crate — a filing bug fixed in one edit — or because the feature under it does not exist, in which case staying open is correct. Read the *known gaps* of the crates the check names before assuming either.
